feeds.title: Standard Ledger Blog
feeds.description: Our story boils down to one thing -strength. Like most startups, in the early days, our strength came from our conviction. We knew startups and fast-growing SMEs needed scalable accounting services, freeing you up for bigger things. And with our operational CFO experience, we knew we could help with those bigger things too, like capital raising, financial management, valuations, and cash injections from R&D tax and grants.

feeds.title: Startup News
feeds.description: Startup News publishes daily articles on news, opinions and interviews with Australian innovators and startups. It has been the home of startup news in Western Australia since 2013. Explore the Startup News and get to know more about owning a startup.

feeds.title: Steve Sammartino Blog
feeds.description: Australia's leading Futurist and International keynote speaker. I have a deep understanding of disruptive technology and the wider economy. Author of 2 best-selling tech strategy books: The Great Fragmentation and The Lessons School Forgot. As a media commentator, I'm a regular on National TV, Radio, and Print providing expert commentary on all things future.

feeds.title: The Startup Magazine » Australia
feeds.description: The Startup Magazine started as a blog for entrepreneurs to share their experiences, and learn from one another. That is still the essence of our work today, as a media company on a mission to be the leading resource of inspiration and education for pioneering early-stage startups and scaleups. Read the latest news articles and blog posts about Australian startups and stay updated.

feeds.title: Inside Small Business » Start-Ups
feeds.description: Inside Small Business delivers essential news, in-depth features, and profiles for Australia's small business community through its magazine, daily news brief, and social media. Each year, the team releases the coveted Top 50 Small Business Leaders report - a tribute to the hard work and resilience of small business owners. The startup section includes news and advice on entrepreneurs, innovation, and Australia's dynamic startup scene.

feeds.title: Dynamic Business
feeds.description: Dynamic Business is the premier destination for SMEs and startups seeking news and expert advice as well as inspiration from leading entrepreneurs. As well as staying abreast of developments in the ever-evolving business landscape to bring readers the latest news, our team is motivated to help people realize and nurture their business ambitions by sharing expert advice, how-to guides, case studies, and inspiring business success stories.

feeds.title: Startup Daily
feeds.description: Startup Daily is a trusted media source covering the Australian and New Zealand startup and tech ecosystems. Startup Daily has been inspiring, educating, and reporting on the Australian tech and startup community since 2012. Not only have they had a front-row seat to watch the development of the Australian innovation ecosystem they have also played a key role in helping it grow.

feeds.title: Lessons At Start Up Blog
feeds.description: The Entrepreneurship Journey! I am a blogger based out of Melbourne and Lessons At Startup is a blog I started a couple of years back to help startup and small business stories grow!

feeds.title: Fishburners Blog
feeds.description: Fishburners is here to support you on your entrepreneurial journey. We are a not-for-profit enterprise dedicated to your enterprise. Our goal is to make the hardest thing you have done easier by providing the best resources, education, mentoring, and a community of like-minded people to connect with and learn from so that your idea can come to life and flourish. Stay up to date with the latest news and developments in the Australian startup space and within the Fishburners community.

feeds.title: Startup Onramp Blog
feeds.description: Startup Onramp is Australia's leading online incubator for early-stage startups We help new and aspiring entrepreneurs to build successful companies by giving you the knowledge, skills, and connections you need to maximize your chances of success. We have worked with several thousand startups and have the deep experience that's needed to give expert practical guidance to first-time entrepreneurs. By learning from successful founders, anyone with an idea for a startup can acquire the skills to launch and grow a globally scalable company

feeds.title: Rebekah Campbell
feeds.description: I lived my twenties and a good part of my thirties with my foot on the floor. I believed that success would come from hard work and tenacity. The harder I pushed the accelerator, the faster I'd win. Find blog posts or archives on my website that will give you tips and tricks for your business startup and how to grow it along with some various different topics related articles.

feeds.title: IT Brief Australia » Start Up
feeds.description: Techday is a purely digital publisher that aspires to be the leading source of technology news globally. We run an extensive network of technology news websites throughout the globe, with sites in Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. Read about A list of all Startup stories on IT Brief Australia.

feeds.title: The Startup Network Blog
feeds.description: We believe that creating a successful startup takes more than one person's idea, it takes a community of generous minds. Gain insights, resources, advice, and knowledge from startup founders and experts in our blogs.

feeds.title: Easy Companies Blog
feeds.description: Starting a business is exciting. Since we started ours in 2013, we've helped hundreds of Australians realize their dreams. We've taken what was at times an overly complex, expensive process, and made it fast, efficient, and affordable. As a result, more people are free to focus on what really inspires them - running their business.

feeds.title: Startup Life Magazine
feeds.description: Startup Life Magazine, the source for small business advice and the latest in business news for startups - we strive to inspire and educate startups. Read Entrepreneur Stories and Insights from Startup Life magazine and stay updated.
